methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia's AI challenge isn't data centers. It's small-business adoption | Guest column - Richmond Times-Dispatch
signals.signal_reading: Commentary highlighting that Virginia's small businesses lack AI adoption capability reveals that infrastructure debates (data centers) overshadow the distributed fluency needed for 'Build It Yourself'—signaling shallow penetration beyond metro tech hubs.

signals.title: New details emerge about Botetourt grid upgrades for Google data center
signals.signal_reading: A $264M grid upgrade for Google's Botetourt data center demonstrates how AI infrastructure investment concentrates in specific sites rather than distributing capability—Southwest gets physical infrastructure but not necessarily workforce fluency or local AI adoption.

signals.title: Israeli AI maritime tech company joins Virginia Beach incubator - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: Israeli maritime AI firm joining Virginia Beach incubator signals Hampton Roads developing sector-specific deep capability tied to its defense/maritime cluster, reinforcing concentrated excellence rather than broad regional AI fluency.

signals.title: 7 rural community colleges receive $5.93 million for healthcare training
signals.signal_reading: Nearly $6M for healthcare training at rural community colleges creates distributed infrastructure for workforce upskilling—if AI-enabled healthcare tools are integrated, this could seed broad fluency outside metro concentration zones.

signals.title: 6 things to know about the Wood Haven deal that we otherwise don’t know much about
signals.signal_reading: Opaque data center negotiations at Wood Haven Technology Park follow NoVA's concentration playbook—Southwest risks becoming infrastructure host without capturing the workforce development or entrepreneurial spillovers that create deep local capability.
